cases.input: Review one bounded pull request against every acceptance criterion and independently assess implementation, tests, security, migrations, architecture, and operational quality with evidence-backed prioritization. The reviewed head is abc123.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate every acceptance criterion independently from implementation quality
produce evidence-backed prioritized findings with smallest safe remediation
bind the review decision and delivery handoff to immutable reviewedHeadSha abc123 and keep delivery closure separate
forbiddenBehaviors: approve solely because CI is green
treat review approval as proof of merge, deployment, release or issue closure

cases.input: The change is technically clean and CI is green, but one acceptance criterion is missing. Keep the quality axis positive while blocking the requirement axis and the overall decision.
requiredBehaviors: block axis 1 for the missing acceptance criterion
recognize the independently strong implementation quality on axis 2
route the smallest correction back to implement-from-issue rather than to delivery follow-up
forbiddenBehaviors: approve the change because tests and CI are green
invent unrelated quality defects to justify the block
skillAnchors: Ein fehlendes oder falsch umgesetztes Kriterium bleibt blockierend

cases.input: A review approved head abc123. Before the handoff, a conflict-resolution commit changes the PR head to abc999. The old review text still says approved and an older CI run is green.
requiredBehaviors: mark the prior approval stale because the head changed after review
refuse to transfer the old review or CI evidence to abc999
require the new immutable head to regain the necessary review evidence before delivery
forbiddenBehaviors: keep approval active because the new commit is small or conflict-only
treat green CI for the old SHA as delivery approval for the new SHA
skillAnchors: Ein neuer Commit, Rebase, Konfliktauflösungs-, Formatierungs- oder sonstiger Head-Wechsel
